data_scope: 10-year nominal Treasury Notes 2008-05-07 to 2026-11-10; FRED DGS10 (Board of Governors H.15 via FRED); Treasury XML all-years cross-check attempted 2008-01-02 to 2026-11-23
disposition: INCONCLUSIVE — mixed or statistically uncertain volatility-forecast evidence
limitations: Daily DGS10 is a reference yield, not an executable price.
Five-observation root-sum-square variation cannot identify intraday futures volatility.
Aggregate bidder classes are not individual bids or a structural elasticity estimate.
record_date is a conservative signal-time convention; no intraday publication timestamp is used.
No missing yield observations are filled; no causal or live-trading claim is made.

methodology.stress: mean trailing-26-event dealer-share percentile and reverse bid-to-cover percentile; threshold 0.75
methodology.target: root-sum-square of five consecutive observed daily DGS10 changes strictly after record_date, bp
methodology.training_rule: prior target end date strictly before current record_date

hybrid_merge.scope_note: Legacy rows supply history through the observed legacy cutoff; only fully reconciled updated rows strictly after that cutoff are appended.
